additional_reviews.review: Direct own-model vision on a bounded genuine montage
observations: M4 preserves more of the upper leaves at view53; M5 upper foliage shows strong missing/strip-like regions and floating specks
Both have residual soft vein/leaf-edge appearance; M5 sometimes preserves local vein contrast at view105
Raw and post differ mainly in small fragments; post does not restore missing M5 upper leaf structure
Pot and blue reference tag are in original RAP foreground; their independent components are not automatically false plant geometry
additional_reviews.limitations: RGB vertex colours are derived from input observations and are not an independent geometric ground truth; 180x320 nearest display cannot establish serration accuracy

additional_reviews.review: Direct own-model vision; same native arrays/nearest overview
observations: Direct NKSR meshes M1/M2 have granular and partly perforated surface appearance, especially pot and leaf overlap; colour-source differences prevent ranking surface precision from texture alone
M2 has more recognizable vein/leaf outline at105 than M1
M3 contains broad extra surface/floaters beyond plant, with red/green ghosts at105 and upper noise at53
M4 keeps recognizable upper leaf/stem structure at53 and smoother surfaces, but texture is soft; M5 upper leaf losses/strip regions remain
additional_reviews.limits: Nearest observation colours differ across direct/Gaussian inputs; judge structure jointly with silhouette/depth/normal, not apparent texture sharpness

additional_reviews.review: Direct own-model vision; native192 edge windows
additional_reviews.legend: Grey overlap with RAP, red missing RAP, blue outside RAP
observations: Common edge windows show missing and false-positive regions; NKSR is not an automatic serration recovery guarantee
Silhouette evidence is relative to RAP prediction, not laser surface truth

additional_reviews.review: Direct own-model vision, native192 GT/RAP-selected common outer-edge crops
observations: All methods have local missing/red or extra/blue geometry; no method consistently restores real fine serrations
M1/M2 expand visible right leaf boundaries at53; M3 is locally closer at some53 edges but fails other/global regions
At105 M3 strongly fills exterior region; TSDF M4/M5 have fine exterior specks/porous fragments, with M4 substantially fewer thanM5
GT/RAP contour is a2D reference, not a validated3D leaf thickness

additional_reviews.review: Direct own-model vision; common depth display origin from original frontend, own-camera gauge
observations: M3 broad exterior depth surface at79 and spikes at53 confirm geometry beyond merely RGB artifacts
M5 broad upper blue-depth plane at53 and extensive exterior specks at79
M4 retains more plausible distinct leaf depth patches; direct M2 has actual pot holes. No independent GT depth is available

additional_reviews.review: Direct own-model vision; primitive world normals transformed to corresponding camera
observations: Normal maps provide real surface orientation evidence; surface discontinuities/noise remain across methods
Normal signs follow geometric winding, not an independently annotated true leaf side; cannot certify thickness or absence of double-layer surfaces
